item.title: Franklin County estate tops February home sales at nearly $4 million
item.description: The most expensive February home sale in Franklin County was a 10,555-square-foot estate in New Albany, which sold for $3.7 million, while the top sale in Delaware County was a 4,260-square-foot new-build in Powell, which sold for $1.484 million.
